# Metadata column_search_by_name

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  table_schema,
  table_name,
  column_name,
  data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE
  column_name LIKE '%price%' OR column_name LIKE '%cost%'
ORDER BY
  table_name,
  column_name
```
